lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy4Mg2Bi2O12 (reduced formula Dy2MgBiO6) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over 7 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Mg and Bi centers each coordinated by six O neighbors in octahedral motifs, while Dy centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 O neighbors. O-centered octahedra share corners and edges with one another and also share corners with 14-vertex O coordination polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional periodic connectivity network.
